## CAPS v1.0.13

### Added
- Added direct QQ Music search and playback for tracks available without QQ Music membership.
- Merged QQ Music results into the Online source alongside NetEase.
- Added QQ Music lyric lookup.
- Added balanced random queues with equal NetEase and QQ Music quotas.

### Changed
- Removed provider suffixes from visible song names while preserving source-aware playback internally.
- Improved remote track loading with buffering progress and background prefetching for the next queued song.
- Queue clicks now start playback immediately.
- Restricted QQ Music tracks are filtered from search results when QQ marks them unavailable for playback.

### Fixed
- Fixed QQ Music vkey and CDN stream resolution.
- Fixed random queue generation returning fewer tracks than requested when only the first QQ search page was used.
- Fixed QQ Music playback requests requiring the correct browser headers and stream fields.

### Contributor
- ref42

## CAPS v1.0.13

### 新增
- 新增 QQ 音乐搜索和播放，限于无需 QQ 音乐会员即可播放的歌曲。
- 将 QQ 音乐结果合并到 Online 来源，与网易云音乐一起展示。
- 新增 QQ 音乐歌词查询。
- 新增网易云音乐与 QQ 音乐配额均衡的随机歌单。

### 调整
- 移除歌曲名称中展示的来源后缀，同时保留内部来源信息以正确播放。
- 优化远程歌曲加载，增加缓冲进度，并在后台预加载队列中的下一首歌曲。
- 点击队列歌曲后立即开始播放。
- QQ 音乐标记为当前不可播放的受限歌曲不再出现在搜索结果中。

### 修复
- 修复 QQ 音乐 vkey 和 CDN 音频流解析。
- 修复随机歌单只使用 QQ 第一页搜索结果导致歌曲数量不足的问题。
- 修复 QQ 音乐播放请求缺少必要浏览器请求头和音频流字段的问题。

### 贡献者
- @ref42
